title: Explicit affine coordinate strict-local rings and fibre comparison data
statement: For a scheme S, an isomorphism e from V to the relative affine space on E = ULift(Fin r) [def-nagata-relative-affine-space], and an algebraically closed field Omega with geometric point v of V [def-weil-geometric-point], define f as e followed by the affine projection; A as the geometric strict local ring at vf [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]; B as that at v; a:A to B as the canonical strict-local map [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-functoriality]; and t_i in B as the structural image [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map] of the global coordinate. For K contained in E define the zero-insertion morphism from the affine space on E minus K to V by its coordinate vector (zero on K, the corresponding coordinate otherwise). Define J as the ideal generated by t_i for i in K; I as the extension of m_A along a; P as (A/m_A)[T_i] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]; and L as the ideal of the variables in K. The conclusion-data type FibreModels(A,B,P,E,K,I,J,L,a,c,t,x,epsilon_A,epsilon_B) records: the residue and polynomial evaluation maps [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation] and their prime kernels; pointed strict-henselization colimit presentations [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization] H0 and H1 of P_q and (P/L)_(q/L) [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] using the separable residue closures inside Omega; coefficient, coordinate and evaluation compatible isomorphisms B/I to H0 and B/(I+J) to H1; and the unique local comparison compatible with the polynomial quotient, geometric residues and quotient map. This defines a type of comparison data and does not assert it is inhabited.

mathlib_searches.query: The closed fibre of the strict henselization of an affine space is the strict henselization of its residue polynomial ring at the geometric prime; setting variables to zero induces the quotient map
mathlib_searches.results: 2026-10-26 msearch: Polynomial.fiberEquivQuotient, Scheme.Hom.fiber, Scheme.residue, IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_quotient_mk, fiberToSpecResidueField_apply, SpecMap_residue, IsLocalRing.comap_closedPoint, stalkClosedPointIso. These supply ordinary fibre, quotient and local-ring tools, not pointed strict-henselization presentations or their simultaneous comparison.
2026-10-26 msearch: zero Mathlib hits. Local rg finds no strict-henselization construction in Mathlib. Existing project comparisons are used in the proof plan.
